tools.name: get_audio_url
tools.description: Get the audio file address for a recitation. With an ayah it returns that ayah (when the reciter has verse-by-verse recordings); without an ayah it returns the full surah file. Use list_reciters for reciter ids.

tools.name: get_ayah
tools.description: Get one ayah in one or more editions side by side, for example reference 2:255 with editions quran-simple and en.sahih. Reference is surah:ayah or a global ayah number (1 to 6236).

tools.name: get_juz
tools.description: Get one juz (1 to 30) in one or more editions. A juz is long, so ask for one or two editions.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get one page (1 to 604) of the standard Madinah mushaf in one or more editions.

tools.name: get_surah
tools.description: Get a surah (1 to 114) in one or more editions. Use from_ayah and to_ayah to read part of a long surah.

tools.name: list_editions
tools.description: List the Quran text editions you can request: Arabic text, translations in many languages, tafsir and transliteration. Filter by language code (for example en, ur, fr) and/or type (translation, tafsir, quran, transliteration). Returns the ids to pass to the verse tools.

tools.name: list_reciters
tools.description: List reciters with audio recitations (recitation per ayah or per surah, mp3/ogg). Filter by language code, or by a name fragment.

tools.name: list_surahs
tools.description: List the 114 surahs with Arabic and English names, number of ayahs, juz, and Meccan/Medinan revelation type.
